newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cerus shares requote at 133 ffr.
newsitem.headline: Cerus shares requote at 133 ffr.

text.p: Shares in Cerus requoted at 133 francs at 0840 GMT, up 11.95 percent from Friday's close, after a newspaper report that CGIP was in talks to buy out Cerus, Italian industrialist Carlo De Benedetti's French holding company.
The stock was suspended limit-up twice earlier.
CGIP and Cerus both declined to comment on the report in the newspaper Les Echos.
Shares in CGIP were down 20 francs at 1,190.
Cerus holds 28 percent of car parts manufacturer Valeo , whose stock was down 4.70 francs at 275 at 0845 GMT.
